channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Is Rochdale Town Hall haunted?
item.description: There is no verified evidence that the Town Hall is haunted — but its Victorian courts, an 1883 fire, local poltergeist tales and commercial ghost-hunt events have kept the rumours alive.

item.title: St Cuthbert's RC High School launches new garden project
item.description: St Cuthbert's RC High School in Rochdale has unveiled a new garden project aimed at enhancing outdoor learning for students.

item.title: Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal opens for donations after helping 3,000 children last year
item.description: The Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal is now accepting donations until 11 December, aiming to support local children in need this festive season.

item.title: Shortlist announced for Raising Rochdale Education Awards 2026
item.description: The shortlist for the Raising Rochdale Education Awards 2026 has been revealed, celebrating local educators' contributions to children's lives.

item.title: Sixteen men charged with violent disorder ahead of court appearance
item.description: Sixteen men have been charged with violent disorder following an incident that occurred on 24 September 2024, before a football match in Manchester. They are currently on bail and are scheduled to appear in court on 4 January 2027. The charges stem from a disturbance that took place prior to the match, which has drawn significant attention due to the nature…

item.title: Rochdale AFC to hold remembrance fixture against York City on 14 November
item.description: Rochdale AFC's home match against York City on Saturday 14 November will serve as a dedicated remembrance fixture.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 10 November 2026
item.description: 15 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Littleborough pub launches new pool league to strengthen community ties
item.description: Admiral Taverns pub in Littleborough invites local venues to join a new pool league, fostering community spirit and competition among players.

item.title: CEAMS wins national award for sustainable manufacturing innovation
item.description: The Centre of Expertise in Advanced Materials and Sustainability (CEAMS) has received national recognition for its innovative work in recycling carbon fibre.

item.title: Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal seeks donations to support local children
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council is calling for donations for its Christmas Toy Appeal, which helps local children in need. Donations are accepted until 11 December 2026.

item.title: Rochdale fighter Owen Webster loses BKFC bout in Glasgow but keeps the town behind him
item.description: Webster was stopped by Dan Morel in the fourth round at the OVO Hydro on Saturday and has thanked the fans who travelled, saying he will be back better than ever.

item.title: Dunelm Rochdale shoppers fill store with Christmas gifts for Delivering Joy appeal
item.description: The Rochdale store says customers have dropped off so many presents in the past week that staff are preparing a count. Gifts go to local causes for people who might otherwise go without.

item.title: School-run parking in Rochdale: what can the council do?
item.description: The council has stepped up patrols outside schools and is consulting on School Streets. New pavement parking powers are on the way from the government.

item.title: Cranmer Education Trust staff gather for professional development event
item.description: Staff from Cranmer Education Trust, which operates schools in Middleton and Oldham, convened for a professional development event aimed at improving children's lives through inclusive education.

item.title: Rochdale man who managed 'Adam' drug line dealers jailed for 10 and a half years
item.description: Haider Ali, 34, of Pike Street, was sentenced at Minshull Street Crown Court on Monday 9 November after an investigation that began with a drug deal on Baron Street.

item.title: Comment: Should fireworks be allowed on any night but bonfire night?
item.description: Rochdale's council displays went quiet this year, but residents say fireworks carried on into this week. We look at the law, the harm to people and animals, and what could change.

item.title: Police warn Rochdale homes to lock away family gold after rise in burglaries
item.description: Burglaries targeting family gold have risen in Rochdale, Oldham and Bury in recent weeks, mostly at weekends, with entry usually gained at the rear of homes.

item.title: Wirral thrash Rochdale 46-0 in rugby match
item.description: Wirral secured a dominant 46-0 victory over Rochdale, moving up to third in the league table ahead of their next match against Leek.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Monday 9 November 2026
item.description: 17 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Volunteers wanted for Rochdale town centre's Saturday night Safe Haven
item.description: Community Medics is recruiting welfare volunteers aged 16 and over for its town centre welfare point, which runs on Saturday nights from 10pm to 3am. Training is provided.

item.title: Free job-search, CV and money advice at Middleton Library today
item.description: Middleton Library is hosting a free work and skills hub on Monday 9 November, with help for job applications, interviews and managing budgets.

item.title: Rochdale South Township Committee meets on Wednesday: when and where
item.description: Rochdale South Township Committee is scheduled to meet at Number One Riverside on Wednesday 11 November. Here is how residents can check the agenda.

item.title: Free Heywood Library friendship group offers a place to meet people this Thursday
item.description: A free drop-in friendship group at Heywood Library on Thursday 12 November is open to adults, with no advance booking required.

item.title: Roadworks on Schofield Street in Heywood to begin on 23 November 2026
item.description: Schofield Street in Heywood will be closed for roadworks from 23 November to 4 December 2026, affecting local traffic and access routes.

item.title: Roadworks to begin on various streets in Rochdale from 23 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced upcoming roadworks affecting various streets starting on 23 November 2026, carried out in two phases.

item.title: RBH tenants rate landlord in top 25 per cent nationally on all 12 survey measures
item.description: National figures from the Regulator of Social Housing place Rochdale Boroughwide Housing in the upper quartile of large landlords on all 12 tenant survey measures for 2025/26.

item.title: The best beauty salons in Rochdale ranked
item.description: An aesthetics clinic in Norden tops Rochdale Daily's ranking of 18 beauty salons across the borough, scored from 5,374 Google and Fresha reviews.

item.title: Elsie Blundell MP attends Middleton Remembrance service as parliamentary wreaths laid across constituency
item.description: Heywood and Middleton North MP Elsie Blundell attended Middleton's service, with wreaths laid on her behalf in Heywood, Castleton, Norden and at Rochdale Cenotaph.

item.title: Woman dies at Tesco in Rochdale after emergency services called
item.description: A woman in her 50s has died following an incident at a Tesco store on Silk Street in Rochdale on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: EdforAll Ltd told to seek planning permission for youth outreach hub in Rochdale
item.description: EdforAll Ltd must apply for planning permission for its youth outreach hub located at Crown Business Park, following a report from the council's planning officer.

item.title: Rochdale holds Remembrance Sunday service to honour fallen heroes
item.description: The Remembrance Sunday parade and service in Rochdale paid tribute to those who lost their lives in conflict.

item.title: How much will Christmas dinner cost in Rochdale? Lidl's £11.11 deal and how rivals compared
item.description: Lidl is first to price its 2026 Christmas dinner. Here is how it stacks up against last year's Aldi, Tesco and Morrisons deals for a family of four.

item.title: Bikers in red leave Birch Services for 13th Ring of Red ride around the M60
item.description: Riders were due to set off from the M62 services at 1pm to form a giant poppy around Manchester, raising money for Heywood Veterans Association.

item.title: Rochdale residents honour fallen heroes with Remembrance Day tributes
item.description: Residents across Rochdale gathered for Remembrance Day services, paying tribute to those who sacrificed their lives in service to the nation.

item.title: Rochdale remembers sacrifices of 6th Battalion, Lancashire Fusiliers in First World War
item.description: A service will be held at the Cenotaph to honour the Rochdale soldiers who fought in the First World War, including the 6th Battalion, Lancashire Fusiliers.

item.title: Castleton Remembrance Sunday service draws big crowd but resident asks for a better speaker next year
item.description: Crowds gathered on Castleton's village green for the Act of Remembrance, but one resident said the words could not be heard.

item.title: Middleton's Veterans' Walk: the poppy mural honouring the town's service men and women on Remembrance Sunday
item.description: A wreath has been laid at Middleton's Veterans' Walk, the Middleton in Bloom mural of poppies, a Spitfire and the white cliffs of Dover.

item.title: How many Rochdale servicemen died in the world wars and since? The records give no single answer
item.description: Between 2,000 and 3,000 Rochdale men are thought to have died in the First World War. No published record gives a borough total for the Second World War or later conflicts.

item.title: Remembrance Sunday: parades and services at eight war memorials across Rochdale borough
item.description: Times and routes for today's Remembrance Sunday parades in Rochdale, Heywood, Middleton, Littleborough, Milnrow, Castleton, Norden and Wardle.

item.title: Plans approved for 21 new apartments in former office block in Rochdale
item.description: St James Place on Yorkshire Street will be transformed into residential apartments after sitting empty for eight years, with planning permission granted for the redevelopment.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Sunday 8 November 2026
item.description: 4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Norden Christmas lights event leads to road closures on 22 November 2026
item.description: Norden will see road closures on 22 November 2026 for the Christmas lights event, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Remembrance walkers cover 22 miles and eight cenotaphs to raise money for veterans
item.description: Get Together After Serving walkers paid their respects at cenotaphs from Norden to Rochdale, with the Mayor joining them at Milnrow.

item.title: Is there really a secret tunnel under Middleton between the Ring O’Bells and St Leonard’s?
item.description: Local tradition says a Civil War escape‑passage ran from the Ring O’Bells to St Leonard’s, but formal records and heritage surveys offer no published proof.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Saturday 7 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: St Luke’s Church in Deeplish to hold Remembrance Day service on 8 November
item.description: St Luke’s Church in Deeplish will hold a Remembrance Day service of Holy Communion on 8 November, officiated by Revd Natty Gray, followed by community refreshments.

item.title: Rochdale care leaver behind Little Acts of Christmas explains why no young person should go without a gift
item.description: Brianna, who grew up in care, started Little Acts of Christmas to give presents to young people in care. Her appeal has passed £900, with more than 30 requests so far.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council supports Good Landlord Charter to enhance rental standards
item.description: The Good Landlord Charter aims to improve private rental standards across Greater Manchester, benefiting both landlords and tenants.

item.title: Drunk driver jailed after Rochdale police pursuit left pedestrian with life-changing injuries
item.description: Cameron Grainger fled officers through Rochdale town centre after a night drinking. A man was seriously injured when he was struck by the police car trying to stop him.

item.title: Greater Manchester Police to host pop-up fraud prevention events in Rochdale
item.description: In a bid to protect shoppers from online fraud, Greater Manchester Police will hold pop-up events in Rochdale next week, providing essential advice and support.
